timeline.summary: 23 Apr 2026: Vodafone Idea disclosed a Section 74 CGST order from the Guwahati (Aizawl-I Range) authority confirming a ₹16.42 lakh penalty plus demand and interest for FY19-FY20 reverse-charge tax; the company will contest it.
30 Apr 2026: DoT committee finalised Vodafone Idea's AGR dues at ₹64,046 Cr as on 31 Dec 2025, down from ₹87,695 Cr frozen, payable from FY2031-32 with the balance in six installments to FY2040-41.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,332 Cr (+2.9% YoY), net profit ₹51,970 Cr (against a loss of ₹7,166.1 Cr a year earlier).
Vodafone Idea board approved issuing up to 430 Cr convertible warrants at ₹11 each to promoter entity Suryaja Investments to raise ₹4,730 Cr.
19 May 2026: Vodafone Idea issued notice for an EGM on June 11, 2026 to seek shareholder approval for a ₹4,730 Cr preferential warrant issue to Suryaja Investments.

20 May 2026: Vodafone Idea signed a Power Purchase Agreement and Share Purchase Agreement to buy 26% of MTK Quantum Green Energy Pvt. Ltd., a captive solar SPV in Tamil Nadu, for ₹4.33 Cr in cash, to complete in about six months.
On 25 May 2026, CRISIL Ratings assigned a CRISIL A- / Stable rating to Vodafone Idea's ₹35,000 crore bank facilities.
ICRA upgraded Vodafone Idea's long-term fund-based term loans to [ICRA] A- (Stable) from [ICRA] BBB.
Grasim Industries Limited, on behalf of promoters including **Kumar Mangalam Birla**, declared no new encumbrances on Vodafone Idea shares as of March 31, 2026, per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Vodafone Idea’s **Pankaj Kapdeo** will attend **Citi India Conference 2026** on **5 June 2026** in Mumbai.

2026-06-08: TRAI levied a ₹15.57 lakh financial disincentive on Vodafone Idea for failing to enforce the UCC scrubbing mechanism in the quarter ended September 2024; the company is reviewing the order.

Vodafone Idea Limited’s shareholders approved Mr. Anil Berera (DIN: 00306485) as Independent Director and Ms. Gopika Pant (DIN: 00388675) as Independent Woman Director via e-voting on 22 October 2026 with 99.80% and 99.70% approval, respectively.
